text.zh-CN:
咳嗽是清除气道刺激物的反射，也是一种症状；它本身不是病因的名称。

- 黏液、烟尘或炎症刺激喉咙和气管，身体会用有力呼气将刺激物排出。干咳不带痰，湿咳会带出分泌物；两种表现都可能有多种原因。
- 感冒、哮喘和反流相关的咳嗽需要不同处理。本页介绍危险变化和就诊线索，具体诊疗由相关病症主题承接。
text.en:
Cough is a reflex that clears airway irritants and a symptom, rather than the name of its cause.

- Mucus, smoke or inflammation can trigger a forceful outward breath. A dry cough brings up no mucus; a wet cough produces secretions. Either pattern can have several causes.
- Cough from a cold, asthma or reflux needs different management. This page explains warning changes and assessment clues and connects to the disease-specific topics.

text.zh-CN:
先区分感染、气道炎症、外界刺激和其他部位的影响，几种原因也可并存。

- 感冒、流感等感染会刺激鼻咽和支气管。咳出的分泌物可携带病原体；预防传播针对感染原因，过敏和反流属于其他机制。
- 哮喘使气道对刺激更敏感；鼻涕往咽喉流、胃内容物反流，也会引发咳嗽。烟草、粉尘和刺激性气体可以加重症状。
- 部分降压或心脏药物，如ACE抑制剂（用于降血压或治疗部分心脏病的一类药），也可能引起干咳。带上药名和使用时间，便于医生核对药物与症状的关系。
text.en:
Consider infection, airway inflammation, inhaled irritants and problems outside the lungs; causes may coexist.

- Colds and influenza irritate the nose, throat and airways. Cough secretions can carry infectious organisms; transmission precautions concern infection, while allergy and reflux are different mechanisms.
- Asthma increases airway sensitivity. Nasal mucus draining into the throat and reflux can also provoke cough. Smoke, dust and fumes can aggravate it.
- Some blood-pressure or heart medicines, such as ACE inhibitors, a class used for high blood pressure or certain heart conditions, can cause dry cough. Bring names and treatment dates to help the clinician assess a connection.

text.zh-CN:
先辨认需要立即急救的呼吸异常和咯血；其他明显变化也要及时评估。

- 喘得说不出话、嘴唇发蓝灰或突然意识混乱，立即呼叫当地急救。不能因为同时咳嗽就把这些表现当成普通感冒。
- 咯血超过少量血丝或小血点、出血持续不停，或咯血同时气短、胸痛、上背痛或心跳很快，立即呼叫当地急救或马上到急诊，不等到嘴唇变色或意识异常。
- 仅少量血丝且没有上述急救表现，也应尽快获得当日评估。咳嗽迅速加重、整体感觉病得很重，或新出现胸痛、呼吸困难时，同样及时求医；达到前述急救条件时直接走急救路径。
text.en:
First identify breathing or bleeding changes needing emergency help; other marked changes also need prompt assessment.

- Call local emergency services for breathlessness preventing speech, blue-grey lips or sudden confusion. A simultaneous cough does not make these ordinary cold symptoms.
- Call local emergency services or obtain emergency care immediately for more than a few blood spots or streaks, bleeding that will not stop, or blood accompanied by breathlessness, chest or upper-back pain, or a very fast heartbeat. Do not wait for color or awareness changes.
- Even a small blood streak without those emergency features needs prompt same-day assessment. Also seek timely care for rapidly worsening cough, feeling very unwell overall, or new chest pain or breathing difficulty; use emergency care whenever the emergency criteria above apply.

text.zh-CN:
轻症观察要看趋势，同时保留明确的就诊条件。

- 短期咳嗽没有危险表现且逐渐改善，可先休息、饮水。出现气短、胸痛、咯血或明显恶化时，按危险信号重新评估。咳嗽持续并妨碍睡眠、上学或工作，也应联系医生。
- 英国NHS建议咳嗽超过3周就诊；美国CDC针对原本健康者的急性支气管炎资料也列出症状超过3周这一条件。体重无故下降、免疫功能受影响或反复发作时，应更早联系医生。
text.en:
Observation of mild symptoms should track their direction and have clear reasons to seek care.

- A short, improving cough without warning signs may initially need rest and fluids. Breathlessness, chest pain, blood or marked deterioration warrants reassessment using the warning-sign advice. Contact a clinician if ongoing cough disrupts sleep, school or work.
- NHS advice recommends review for cough over 3 weeks; CDC advice for acute bronchitis in otherwise healthy people uses symptoms over 3 weeks too. Unexplained weight loss, impaired immunity or repeated episodes warrant earlier contact.

text.zh-CN:
检查寻找原因和严重程度，不给每次咳嗽安排同一套影像。

- 医生会问开始时间、是否有痰、夜间或活动时是否更重、发热和接触史，并了解吸烟、药物及既往心肺病。听诊可发现呼吸声音变化。
- 胸片帮助查看肺部，肺功能检查测量呼气情况，痰液检查用于寻找感染线索。按表现选择项目；干湿类型或痰色只是线索，要结合其他发现解释。
text.en:
Assessment seeks the cause and severity rather than applying one imaging package to every cough.

- The clinician asks about onset, mucus, night or activity-related symptoms, fever and contacts, plus smoking, medicines and heart or lung history. Listening checks for altered breathing sounds.
- Chest imaging examines the lungs, lung-function testing measures breathing performance and sputum testing investigates infection. Tests follow the presentation; cough type or mucus color is one clue interpreted with other findings.

text.zh-CN:
相似的咳嗽可能来自不同系统，伴随表现有助于区分。

- 流鼻涕、咽痛和接触病人支持感染线索；花粉接触后喷嚏提示过敏；喘鸣或活动后发作可涉及哮喘。任何一个线索都需要结合病程。
- 反酸、烧心或鼻涕倒流可解释部分持续咳嗽；但突然气短和胸痛可能涉及肺栓塞或气胸，肺炎可伴发热及呼吸异常。严重原因需要医疗评估。
text.en:
Similar coughs can arise from different systems; accompanying findings help distinguish them.

- Runny nose, sore throat and sick contacts suggest infection; sneezing after pollen exposure suggests allergy; wheeze or activity-related episodes may involve asthma. Each clue needs the surrounding history.
- Reflux or nasal drainage can explain persistent cough. Sudden breathlessness with chest pain may reflect pulmonary embolism or a collapsed lung; pneumonia may cause fever and breathing changes. Serious causes need assessment.

text.zh-CN:
治疗既减轻咳嗽的不适，也处理已经查明的原因。

- 普通病毒感染可先休息、补水；确认为哮喘相关时，医生可用吸入治疗改善气道炎症或狭窄。鼻部过敏、反流或药物诱发的咳嗽，分别处理对应原因。
- 没有哮喘等基础气道病时，英国NICE不建议为急性上呼吸道感染或支气管炎的咳嗽常规使用支气管扩张药或激素。肺炎和百日咳另有治疗路径。
text.en:
Treatment reduces the burden of cough and addresses an identified cause.

- An uncomplicated viral illness may need rest and fluids. Asthma-related cough may need inhaled therapy for airway inflammation or narrowing. Nasal allergy, reflux and medicine-related cough need their own management.
- NICE advises against routine bronchodilators or corticosteroids for acute upper-respiratory infection or bronchitis without underlying airway disease such as asthma. Pneumonia and pertussis have separate pathways.

text.zh-CN:
先确认药物针对疼痛、鼻部症状、气道炎症还是感染，再讨论是否适合。

- 多数普通急性支气管炎可自行恢复，抗生素不能让病毒性咳嗽更快痊愈；肺炎或百日咳需要另行判断。抗生素也可有皮疹、严重过敏和腹泻等风险。
- 非处方止咳药只可能短暂减轻症状。NHS和NICE指出，可待因和鼻减充血药对这类急性咳嗽缺乏帮助；症状被压住不等于病因已经解决。
- 儿童、孕期使用前先查说明书并咨询药师。复方感冒药可能重复含有对乙酰氨基酚等成分；不要叠加使用或把成人制剂直接给儿童。
text.en:
Identify whether a medicine targets discomfort, nasal symptoms, airway inflammation or infection before deciding whether it fits.

- Most uncomplicated acute bronchitis resolves without antibiotics, which do not speed recovery from viral cough. Pneumonia and pertussis require separate decisions. Antibiotics can cause rash, severe allergy and diarrhea.
- Nonprescription products may give temporary relief. NHS and NICE describe little help from codeine or decongestants for this acute cough; symptom suppression does not establish resolution of the cause.
- Check labels and ask a pharmacist before use in children or pregnancy. Combination products may duplicate ingredients such as acetaminophen; avoid overlapping products or adult preparations for children.

text.zh-CN:
饮食主要帮助舒适和补水，额外限制取决于明确的原因。

- 饮水帮助维持水分。蜂蜜可用于1岁及以上人群的急性咳嗽，但效果证据有限；不喂给未满1岁婴儿，也不要给幼儿烫饮。
- 成人经评估发现反流参与咳嗽后，可观察咖啡、酒精、高脂或辛辣食物是否诱发自己的反流症状，并讨论减少相关食物和调整晚餐时间。成人反流资料不直接用于儿童饮食；仅凭咳嗽也不要求人人禁食同一清单。
text.en:
Food and fluids support comfort and hydration; extra restrictions depend on the established cause.

- Fluids support hydration. Honey may help acute cough from age 1, with limited benefit evidence; do not give it to younger babies or give young children scalding drinks.
- After assessment finds reflux contributing to an adult’s cough, check whether coffee, alcohol, fatty or spicy foods trigger that person’s reflux symptoms and discuss targeted changes and evening meal timing. Adult reflux advice does not directly determine a child’s diet, and cough alone does not justify identical food bans for everyone.

text.zh-CN:
记录病程和伴随变化，帮助决定是否需要检查或调整治疗。

- 记下开始日期、睡眠影响、痰和血、发热、气短、烟尘接触及用药。就诊时带上记录，便于区分感染、过敏和其他原因。
- 休息，减少烟草和刺激性空气接触；使用加湿器时保持清洁。新出现胸痛、呼吸困难或血痰，停止只做家庭护理；咯血超过少量血丝、出血持续不停或咯血伴气短、胸部或上背痛时，按危险信号立即急救。
text.en:
Track the course and accompanying changes to guide assessment or treatment review.

- Record onset, sleep disruption, mucus or blood, fever, breathlessness, smoke exposure and medicines. Bring this information to distinguish infection, allergy and other causes.
- Rest, reduce smoke or irritant exposure and keep any humidifier clean. New chest pain, breathing difficulty or blood means moving beyond home care. More than a few blood streaks, bleeding that will not stop, or blood with breathlessness or chest/upper-back pain requires the immediate action described under warning signs.

text.zh-CN:
年龄、孕期及原有疾病会改变观察和用药的边界。

- 小婴儿咳嗽应更早联系医疗人员。不足3个月且体温达到38℃时，美国CDC建议立即联系医务人员，英国NHS也要求紧急咨询；若同时呼吸困难或反应异常，按危险信号急救。儿童治疗不是把成人方案简单缩小剂量。
- 老人合并重要心、肺、肾等疾病，或接受化疗、免疫抑制治疗者，不直接套用原本健康者的支气管炎居家建议；孕期也需确认药物是否适合。
text.en:
Age, pregnancy and underlying illness change the limits of observation and medicine use.

- Contact a clinician earlier for a young infant with cough. For a child under 3 months with a temperature of 38°C or more, CDC advises immediate clinician contact and NHS advises urgent consultation. Breathing difficulty or abnormal responsiveness also requires the emergency warning-sign pathway. Pediatric care is not an adult regimen with a smaller dose.
- Older people with significant heart, lung or kidney disease, or people receiving chemotherapy or immune suppression, should not simply apply bronchitis self-care advice for otherwise healthy people. Pregnancy requires checking medicine suitability.

text.zh-CN:
恢复速度取决于病因；咳嗽减轻和睡眠、活动恢复都是观察点。

- 英国NHS和NICE说明普通急性咳嗽可持续3至4周。这不是出现危险信号后继续等待的理由；超过3周仍咳嗽可安排评估。
- 治疗后仍反复、加重或妨碍睡眠与生活，复诊时重新核对病因、用药和暴露。持续咳嗽可能需要呼吸专科评估，不应一轮轮重复同样的感冒药。
text.en:
Recovery depends on the cause; easing cough and returning sleep and activity are useful observations.

- NHS and NICE describe a usual acute-cough course of up to 3–4 weeks. This does not justify waiting through warning signs; ongoing cough beyond 3 weeks warrants assessment.
- Recurrent, worsening or disruptive cough after treatment warrants review of the cause, medicines and exposures. Persistent cough may need respiratory assessment rather than repeated courses of the same cold remedies.

text.zh-CN:
分清咳嗽带来的生活负担，与引起咳嗽的疾病造成的损害。

- 长时间咳嗽可打断睡眠，使人疲劳，或造成肌肉酸痛、漏尿和咳后呕吐；这些影响值得在复诊时提出。
- 肺炎、气胸或心力衰竭有各自风险，不是普通咳嗽必然发展成的疾病。新出现气短、胸痛或血痰，应重新评估原因。
text.en:
Separate the burden of coughing from harm caused by the underlying illness.

- Prolonged cough may disrupt sleep, cause fatigue, muscle soreness, urine leakage or vomiting after bouts; discuss these effects during review.
- Pneumonia, a collapsed lung and heart failure have their own risks; ordinary cough does not inevitably progress to them. New breathlessness, chest pain or blood needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
预防按原因区分：减少感染传播，也减少气道刺激和已知诱因。

- 注意洗手、咳嗽遮挡和室内空气流通，按当地建议接种相关疫苗；发热或不适到不能正常活动时减少接触他人。
- 避免吸烟和二手烟，减少自己已知的粉尘或过敏诱因。哮喘和反流相关复发要落实对应病因的控制，不能只备止咳糖浆。
text.en:
Prevention is cause-specific: reduce infection spread, airway irritation and known triggers.

- Use hand hygiene, cover coughs and improve indoor air; follow local vaccine recommendations. Reduce contact with others when you have a fever or feel too unwell to do your usual activities.
- Avoid smoking and secondhand smoke and reduce known dust or allergy exposures. Asthma- or reflux-related recurrence depends on treating that condition, not merely carrying cough syrup.

limitations.zh-CN: 各节列出已阅读的资料；适用地区和待补证据保存在编辑记录中。
limitations.en: Each section links material that was read; regional applicability and evidence gaps are retained in the editorial record.
